runs.text:
space , space makes it easier to tell some stories
it gives time for skin to grow back
it (un)furrows the brow
they say three generations down is a good time to recount stories

2018, i walk through the memorial museum
mindlessly following a history assignment
skulls with bullet holes behind glass
oil lamps flickering in a dimly lit room
1938, painted in red and black 
in the shape of a handgun
before i think to return, the museum comes down
its wooden walls no match
for the glass towers closing in

1938, my great grandpa gives his last breath
to the Stalinist repression of 
scholars, monks, and leaders

i grieve the loss of fertile minds 
and honor my great grandpa’s grace

what more grace than bowing,
bowing into the pearl felt

dancing through the steppes into your bed
offering your heart to the fire spirits of the hearth
to reunite with source
dirt, earth, breath

what more generosity than donating the bullet
back to the hands of the red
turning lead into grass
blood into spring water
i daydream of an alternate universe

what joy and prosperity
is in the alternate universe
in which our people survived
even greater joy
in the one
in which our people
